verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships a conversational Repository Agent that can browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push, which covers the 'insights into repositories' half of the story (docs-29, docs-64). There is no evidence the agent can open pull requests. The manual's mention of creating 'these' for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab is unclear in scope and is not tied to the agent (docs-19). missing for 10: agent-driven pull request creation, documentation of the agent's analysis/insight depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent.
